title: Floor 4 The Main Event arena remaining slices
description: Materialize the remaining implementation issues for Floor 4's Main Event arena epic from .specify/specs/floor4-arena.md. Slice 1 is already implemented, so this graph starts with slice 2 and preserves the planned implementation order.

review.body: Source of truth: .specify/specs/floor4-arena.md, docs/knowledge/game-design/floor4-arena.md, and ADR 0090. Human review should confirm this file still matches the remaining slice plan before closing as completed.

nodes.title: Floor 4 Slice 2: phase machine, arena clock, and headless route
nodes.body: Implement arenaDirectorSystem for the Floor 4 empty broadcast rehearsal: clock, phases, transitions, scenario-pipeline wiring into real sim/headless paths, RunStats phase timeline, and deterministic headless traversal. Prerequisite outside this epic file: slice 1 floor plumbing and arena map must be landed.

nodes.title: Floor 4 Slice 3: deterministic waves, manifests, gates, cap, debt, and cut
nodes.body: Implement Floor 4 waves from the spec: enemies.floor4.json, per-act rosters/threat costs, immutable seeded wave manifests, release cursor, concurrency cap, spawn debt, cut behavior, and gate telegraphs.

nodes.title: Floor 4 Slice 4: Headliner card, encounters, rewards, and overtime
nodes.body: Implement Headliner pool data and seeded draw, act-slot encounter identity, entry/announcement, boss chest plus appearance fee, overtime ramp/cap, and boss-abilities.floor4.json.

nodes.title: Floor 4 Slice 5: Green Room intermission transaction and shops
nodes.body: Implement the Green Room transaction from the spec: sealed safe room, shop tables, per-visit seeded stock roll and retirement, purchase/sell/equip surfaces, exit/stairs hand-off, and invariants that no hostile activity occurs during visits.

nodes.title: Floor 4 Slice 6: arena HUD and feedback surfaces
nodes.body: Implement Floor 4 act clock, overtime state, wave pips, Headliner banner, cut notice, break summary, and Winner's Circle UX with deterministic visual checks.

nodes.title: Floor 4 Slice 7: economy tuning, balance, win-rate gate, and achievements
nodes.body: Implement per-act income budgets, price bands, Floor 4 tuning, tests/headless/floor4-arena-completion.test.ts win-rate gate, achievements/quests data, and seed-sweep evidence. Broad sweeps must use GitHub infrastructure by default.

nodes.title: Floor 4 Slice 8: optional Floor 3 kept-companion co-star
nodes.body: Consume the Floor 3 KeptCompanionContract as an optional additive ally for Floor 4. Runs without a carried companion must remain unchanged and balance must not depend on the co-star.
